text.p: A total of 1.2 million shares in Russian natural gas monopoly RAO Gazprom changed hands in electronic trading on Friday at an average 2,744 roubles ($0.485) a share, up from 2,642 roubles at the previous session on February 12, the Federal Securities Corporation (FFK) said.
Full details of the trading session:
Prices have risen from an average 406.60 roubles a share at the first auction on March 6, 1996. Prices reached a record average 3,015.78 roubles at the auction on October 21, 1996.
Gazprom is one of Russia's biggest companies by market capitalisation but its 23.6 billion shares are highly illiquid because of company restrictions on selling them.
The company has organised regular auctions and electronic trading sessions to create an orderly market in its paper.
Gazprom was $0.484 at 1310 GMT on Friday on the Russian Trading System, up from $0.478 on Thursday.
Its American Depositary Shares were $16.675 after $17.800. One ADS is equivalent to 10 ordinary shares.
The next electronic trading sessions will be held on February 19, 21.
